name: Point of Sale
description: Full POS system with cash and card payments, barcode scanning, invoicing, purchase orders, and inventory integration. Supports pluggable payment gateways (Stripe, Square, manual card entry).
author: CDAC Programming
features: Register management with cash drawer sessions
Product search by SKU, UPC, or name with barcode scanner support
Credit card processing via pluggable payment gateways
Manual card entry for external terminals
Stripe and Square gateway stubs (ready to configure)
Invoice creation and management with PDF generation
Purchase order management with inventory receiving
Automatic inventory stock deduction on sale
Full audit trail on all transactions
